summary.text: Shahana Hanif represents the 39th District on the New York City Council, which includes parts of Park Slope, Kensington, Borough Park, Gowanus, Carroll Gardens and Cobble Hill in Brooklyn.
Her Council biography says she is the first Bangladeshi and Muslim woman elected to the Council and the first woman to represent the district.

paragraphs.text: Hanif was born and raised in the district to Bangladeshi immigrant parents, according to her Council biography, and was diagnosed with Lupus at age 17.
Before her election she was Director of Organizing and Community Engagement in the office of then-Council Member Brad Lander, where she led Participatory Budgeting.

Since her election in 2021 she has passed Local Law 85 of 2023 on universal residential composting, Local Laws 75 and 76 of 2022 on abortion rights, and Local Law 161 of 2023 creating an Immigrant Workers Bill of Rights.
She also enacted Local Law 45 of 2024, providing domestic violence survivors with free lock changes, safety alarms and door and window repairs.
She sits on the Committees on Transportation and Infrastructure and on Sanitation and Solid Waste Management.
